idea-plugin.name: DeepSeek Harness for Rider
idea-plugin.description:
Connects JetBrains Rider to a locally running DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (dsh web, http://127.0.0.1:3080).
Select a file, a line, or a block of code in the editor and send it straight to your harness with one click. Replies stream back into the dedicated "DeepSeek" tool window, where you can also answer questions, allow or reject tool approvals, type follow-up prompts, and jump to the full Web GUI at any time.
Features: - "Ask DeepSeek" on editor selection / current line / whole file (context menu, Tools menu, Alt+Shift+D) - Streaming assistant replies in the Rider tool window - Approval cards (allow once / reject) and question cards answered without leaving Rider - One persistent harness session per Rider project (session cwd = project root), reusable across restarts - Configurable session policy, context size caps and default question template
Requires a running DeepSeek Harness Web GUI on this machine ("dsh web").
